about_paragraph: I build mobile apps with React Native and Expo, and web products with React, Next.js and Vue. I’ve shipped five apps to the App Store and Google Play — three of them from scratch — from an offline messenger running over a Bluetooth mesh to an audio guide that plays by location with the screen locked.
job_pecode_b1: Worked on 7 mobile and 2 web projects; owned builds, TestFlight testing and releases to the App Store and Google Play.
job_pecode_b2: Built an offline messenger that connects to mesh devices over Bluetooth Low Energy, syncs messages after reconnecting and shows friends on offline Mapbox maps.
job_pecode_b3: Single-handedly built and released an audio guide: outdoors, audio starts by geolocation even with the screen locked; indoors, with a tap on an NFC tag. Automated store builds with GitHub Actions and EAS.
job_pecode_b4: Integrated image analysis and RevenueCat subscriptions; built a Next.js site with a lead form and price calculator scoring 95–100 in all four Lighthouse categories.
job_pecode_b5: Prepared 10+ project estimates, worked directly with clients, ran code reviews and onboarded new developers.
job_hys_b1: Built core screens of a React Native healthcare app where users track their progress in real time.
job_hys_b2: Built a Next.js admin portal for user data; TanStack Query caching cut loading states on pages by more than 50%.
job_hys_b3: Created multilingual interfaces for a B2B portal on Vue and Pinia, integrated REST APIs and added inline form validation.
job_hys_b4: Integrated PostHog analytics from scratch: finding the cause of a production issue went from hours to a few minutes.
job_hys_b5: Migrated a site from Vue to React. Teams of 6–9, international clients, English.
